name: pipenet
title: Pipe network
description: Lay out a fluid loop on a grid: one source, any number of sinks, joined by straights, elbows, tees and crossovers. Writes the upstream matrix and each segment's length, diameter and fitting counts into the sheet, for Crane, Hooper 2-K or Darby 3-K fitting losses, and draws the sheet's flows and pressure drops on the pipes. Comes with the sheet that solves the loop.
